
# Project Guidelines

This is an existing Vue 3, TypeScript and InversifyJS application.

## General Principles

- Follow existing project architecture and naming conventions.
- Apply Clean Architecture, SOLID and pragmatic Software Craftsmanship.
- Inspect similar existing implementations before writing new code.
- Preserve established architectural layers, including use cases for CRUD operations when this is the existing convention.
- Do not introduce new dependencies or architectural patterns without justification.
- Avoid unnecessary abstractions and unrelated refactoring.
- Respect existing ESLint, Prettier and TypeScript configurations.
- Keep changes within the requested scope.
- Add or update relevant tests.
- Run available checks and report their results.
- Explain significant architectural decisions and trade-offs.

## Specialized Instructions

Follow applicable instructions in `.github/instructions/` for architecture, dependency injection, Vue and testing.
